svg.title: Disclaimer
svg.desc: Four caveats before the talk: an independent project not affiliated with the tools it names; small experiments, mostly one run each on a local kind cluster; tool comparisons read from public documentation; and a hypothesis that has not been tested with users.

svg.text: Mostly one run each, on a local kind cluster with PostgreSQL 16. They are observations,

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not benchmarks, and they say nothing about production scale.

svg.text: of date or wrong. Corrections are welcome.
